name: Repositories Explorer
description: View, search, filter, and manage all source code repositories, health scores, and connected agents.

name: Repository Overview
description: Comprehensive dashboard for a specific repository showing active branches, commit activity, AI agent status, and recent deployments.

name: Branch Protection Rules
description: Configure branch protection policies, required reviewer approvals, AI agent status checks, auto-merge conditions, and force-push locks.

name: Preview Environments
description: Manage ephemeral preview environments spun up automatically for Pull Requests, view live URLs, logs, and tear-down triggers.

name: Slack & Webhook Integrations
description: Configure Slack notification channels, incoming webhook URLs, event subscriptions for build failures, security alerts, and agent comments.

name: Agent Orchestration Config
description: Configure multi-agent coordination, agent execution schedules, concurrency limits, auto-trigger policies on commit/PR, and agent model selection.

name: Auto-Rollback Thresholds & Policies
description: Configure automated rollback thresholds based on error rates, latency spikes, health check failures, and canary degradation.

name: CI/CD Build & Test Pipelines
description: Real-time build logs, test execution matrices, artifact storage, and pipeline step latency analysis.

name: AI Code Reviewer Agent
description: Inspect automated code review comments, suggested refactors, syntax/lint violations, and approve or reject agent suggestions.

name: Security & Vulnerability Scanner
description: SAST/DAST static security analysis, CVE vulnerability alerts, dependency auditing, and secret leak detection.

name: Release Summarizer & Changelog
description: AI-generated release notes, changelog compilation across merged PRs, semantic version tagging, and stakeholder digests.

name: Environment Secrets & Vault
description: Manage encrypted environment variables, API tokens, deployment keys, and cloud credentials scoped by environment.

name: Code Health & Technical Debt
description: Analyze maintainability index, code complexity, test coverage trends, duplicated code percentage, and technical debt score.

name: Assistant Memory Management
description: Inspect, edit, or purge episodic memory facts, preferences, and distilled conversation history stored by the AI assistant.
